name: Omaudix: Media Visualizer
author: qempexe
description: Now-playing bar widget with eight live visualizers (cava or built-in), left/right placement, and fixed-width scrolling track text.

barWidget.description: Visualizer, scrolling artist - title and playback controls

schema.label: Visualizer style
schema.description: bars, mirror, wave (smooth blob), scope (real oscilloscope), dots, led (segmented meter), ring (radial) or area (filled mountain).

schema.label: Visualizer position
schema.description: Which side of the text the visualizer sits on. 'both' mirrors it on each side.

schema.label: Visualizer width
schema.description: How wide the visualizer is. The ring style stays square.

schema.label: Bar count
schema.description: Number of frequency bands for the spectrum styles.

schema.label: Color mode
schema.description: theme follows the bar foreground; fade ramps its opacity; rainbow shifts hue; custom uses the color below.

schema.label: Custom color
schema.description: Hex color like #7aa2f7 (used when Color mode is custom).

schema.label: Sensitivity
schema.description: Extra gain applied after the engine's own auto-leveling.

schema.label: Smoothing
schema.description: Higher values make bars fall more slowly.

schema.label: Frame rate
schema.description: Visualizer updates per second. Lower saves CPU.

schema.label: Spectrum engine
schema.description: auto uses cava when installed and falls back to the built-in FFT. The scope style always uses its own capture.

schema.label: Player
schema.description: Which media player to follow: auto (whatever is playing) or a player's D-Bus name. Easiest to change from the Player tab in the widget's settings panel.

schema.label: Show track text
schema.description: Show the artist and title next to the visualizer.

schema.label: Shrink to short titles
schema.description: Titles that fit are shown at their own width, so the buttons sit right next to them. Off keeps the text area at a fixed width.

schema.label: Text format
schema.description: What the text shows and in which order.

schema.label: Separator
schema.description: Placed between artist and title.

schema.label: Max text width
schema.description: Widest the text area can get. Longer titles scroll instead of growing the widget.

schema.label: Scroll direction
schema.description: How text that does not fit moves: left, right, bounce back and forth, or off (truncate).

schema.label: Scroll speed
schema.description: How fast overflowing text moves.

schema.label: Scroll pause
schema.description: How long the text waits (in milliseconds) before each scroll so the start can be read.

schema.label: Text alignment
schema.description: Alignment of text that fits without scrolling.

schema.label: Show playback controls
schema.description: Previous, play/pause and next buttons.

schema.label: Controls position
schema.description: Which end of the widget holds the buttons.

schema.label: Hide when paused
schema.description: Remove the widget from the bar while nothing is playing. Off by default so the widget is always visible.

schema.label: Pause the old player when a new one starts
schema.description: When another player starts playing (from outside Omaudix), pause whatever else was playing. Off by default.

schema.label: Cover art on the bar
schema.description: Show the song's cover (a note icon when there is none) on the bar. left: before everything, center: right before the text, right: after everything.

schema.label: Cover size
schema.description: Size of the cover on the bar.

schema.label: Click action
schema.description: Left click on the visualizer or text. Middle click always skips to the next track.

schema.label: Scroll wheel action
schema.description: track skips songs; style cycles the visualizer style until the shell restarts.

schema.label: Show album art
schema.description: Display the current track's cover art in the settings popup header.
